body.x: Zolt(www.gozolt.com), a provider of compact-size adaptors, unveiled Zolt Laptop Charger Plus at Digital Experience, the press party before the official opening of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Zolt Laptop Charger Plus is the laptop charger that is four times smaller and three times lighter than regular laptop chargers at just three inches long and three ounces. Each Zolt Plus features three USB ports, giving users an all-in-one charger for three devices. Zolt’s patented ERC (Efficient Resonant Control) technology automatically regulates power for each connected device, ensuring fastest charging while preserving battery life.
